messages:
Rina (CS): Drafting a super-short customer-facing 'orchestration cheat-card' for pilots. Need a quick review — want it concise for email.

Evan (Eng): Keep it to 3 actionable tech settings + 1 example snippet. Recommend conservative defaults.

Rina (CS): Proposed 3 actions for customers:
1) Enable route cache (TTL=60s); use key pattern tenant|route|prompt_prefix.
2) Set client batch window = 50ms OR flush at 8 requests.
3) Turn on streaming for interactive flows to surface partials.

Sohail (SRE): Add warm-pool guidance: suggest "start small" wording — e.g., 2–4 warm workers per 10 tenants, with 0–20s jitter. Share readiness probe example.

Evan (Eng): Example SDK pseudocode for batching we can share:
```js
batcher.add(req)
setTimeout(() => batcher.flush(), 50)
if (batch.length >= 8) batcher.flush()
```
Also add token-budget starter: 5k tokens/day per active seat (adjust with telemetry).

Nora (PM): Renewal-risk mapping (short): low usage (7d MAU -40%) -> outreach; QoE regression (p95 >2x for 48h) -> escalate + fallback to smaller model; error spike (>1% + ticket) -> bridgecall.

Rina (CS): Great. I'll produce the one-line email snippet: "Before go-live: set token budget, enable route cache (60s), enable streaming; we'll monitor and recommend adjustments within 72h." Ops-bot: create runbook link please.

ops-bot: Runbook created: cs/pilot-orch-cheatcard-v1 :page_facing_up:

Rina (CS): Thanks — I'll upload the one-pager and the internal checklist this afternoon. :thumbsup:
